facts.fact: Statistics Botswana released its Vital Statistics Report 2024 in August 2026, compiled from the Births and Deaths Registration System and Department of Civil and National Registration records, covering births, deaths and marriages registered in 2024 (49,180 births, 14,070 deaths).
Statistics Botswana released its Vital Statistics Report 2024 in August 2026, covering births and deaths registered in 2024 (49,180 births and 14,070 deaths registered) from civil registration data.
